set_pass_through_credentials: set API credentials for a pass-through LLM endpoint by provider, base URL, and API key
get_credentials: get credentials for a pass-through LLM endpoint by provider and optional region name
set_default_vertex_config: set default Vertex AI pass-through config from a dictionary or environment variables
add_vertex_credentials: add Vertex AI credentials for a specific project ID and location pair
get_vertex_credentials: get Vertex AI credentials for a project ID and location, falling back to default config
